document: Course Title: Algorithms and Problem Solving (15B11C1411). Institute: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology, Noida. Exam: TEST2 Examination, 2025 (BTech/Dual CSE 4th Semester). Max Time: 1 Hr. Max Marks: 20.

Q1. Ford-Fulkerson network flow with DFS. (a) Compute maximum flow from S to T and show augmenting paths. (b) Worst-case time complexity. (c) Compare DFS vs BFS performance in finding augmenting paths.

metadata.subject: ALGO
metadata.co_description: Analyze the complexity of different algorithms using asymptotic analysis.

document: Q2. Project scheduling with deadlines and profits. Develop greedy algorithmic approach and pseudocode to maximize profit and find optimal schedule.

metadata.subject: ALGO
metadata.co_description: Apply algorithmic principles for solving a given problem.

document: Q3. File merging problem for sales reports of varying sizes. (a) Optimal merge pattern algorithm. (b) Calculate minimum merge cost for report sizes [5, 8, 3, 6, 2, 9, 4, 7] MB.

metadata.subject: ALGO
metadata.co_description: Identify, formulate and design an efficient solution to a given problem using appropriate data structure and algorithm design technique.

document: Q4. String matching for pattern P='BARBARIC'. (a) KMP algorithm detection, LPS table role and construction. (b) Construct finite automaton for alphabet set (A,B,C,D,E,I,R).
